tasks.label: Gaussian: setup
tasks.detail: Create .venv-gaussian, install pinned Python/npm deps, download Brush v0.3.0 (once).

tasks.label: Gaussian: quick smoke test
tasks.detail: 4 stations, 300 steps, tiny model. A few minutes. Never publishable.

tasks.label: Gaussian: train May 6
tasks.detail: Full 50k-step run (38-118 min, saturates the GPU). Output in work/gaussian/. Does not publish.

tasks.label: Gaussian: train Sep 17
tasks.detail: Full 50k-step run (38-118 min, saturates the GPU). Output in work/gaussian/. Does not publish.

tasks.label: Gaussian: train Sep 17 (mask nadir)
tasks.detail: Same as Sep 17 but drops the downward faces where the camera operator appears.

tasks.label: Gaussian: train Sep 17 (mask nadir, watch live)
tasks.detail: Same as the mask-nadir run, plus Brush opens a live window showing the scene as it trains.

tasks.label: Gaussian: list zones
tasks.detail: Show the Sep 17 training zones: stations, owner and status (reads scripts/gaussian_zones.json).

tasks.label: Gaussian: train zone…
tasks.detail: Train ONE zone of the Sep 17 capture (pick the id; claim it first in scripts/gaussian_zones.json). Nadir masked. Output in work/gaussian/2026-09-17/<zone>/. Does not publish.

tasks.label: Gaussian: train zone… (Oct 18, choose seed)
tasks.detail: Train ONE zone of the Oct 18 capture with an explicit random seed (reproducibility experiments: run 42, 43, 44 and report mean ± sd). Nadir masked. Does not publish.

tasks.label: Gaussian: train all zones (owner)
tasks.detail: Owner only: train every Sep 17 zone one after another (resumable; finished zones are skipped). Occupies the GPU for hours.

tasks.label: Gaussian: preview locally
tasks.detail: Serve the repo on 127.0.0.1:8000 and print viewer URLs (with ?manifest override) for the newest run of the chosen capture.

tasks.label: Gaussian: list zones (Oct 18)
tasks.detail: List the Oct 18 (Level 1) training zones: stations, owner and status (reads scripts/gaussian_zones.json).

tasks.label: Gaussian: train zone… (Oct 18)
tasks.detail: Train ONE zone of the Oct 18 (Level 1) capture (pick the id; claim it first in scripts/gaussian_zones.json). Nadir masked. Output in work/gaussian/2026-10-18/<zone>/. Does not publish.

tasks.label: Gaussian: train Oct 18 (mask nadir, whole floor)
tasks.detail: Train the whole Oct 18 Level 1 capture as ONE scene (nadir masked), not per zone. Output in work/gaussian/2026-10-18/. Does not publish.

tasks.label: Gaussian: show trained zone on local web (Oct 18)
tasks.detail: Copy the newest finished (non-quick) run of the chosen Oct 18 zone to scan-assets/gaussian/2026-10-18/zones/ (local-only, not published to the site), refresh work/local-test.html and print the viewer URL (http://127.0.0.1:8790/scan-compare.html?capture=2026-10-18&mode=splat). Keeps the existing alignment label.

tasks.label: Gaussian: train zone + show on local web (Oct 18)
tasks.detail: Train the chosen Oct 18 zone (full run, saturates the GPU), then put it on the local web viewer. Local-only; nothing is pushed.
dependsOn: Gaussian: show trained zone on local web (Oct 18)

tasks.label: Gaussian: train zone… (Oct 18, Level 3)
tasks.detail: SUPERSEDED 2026-10-20: Level 3 will be re-scanned; do not train this preset. Kept for provenance.

tasks.label: Colleague: train Level 1 Zone B (Oct 18)
tasks.detail: Train zone l1-b of the Oct 18 capture with the preset's full 50,000 steps (growth stop 30,000, 1M splats, 768 px, nadir masked); do not shorten with --steps. Output in work/gaussian/2026-10-18/l1-b/. Does not publish. If the GPU runs out of memory, re-run from a terminal with --max-splats 500000.

tasks.label: Gaussian: update progress map
tasks.detail: Regenerate the Gaussian zone progress map (scripts/gaussian_progress_map.py) into the Desktop 'Research stuff' folder on Mac, Desktop\Gaussian_Progress on Windows. Read-only for the repo.

tasks.label: Local: serve site (8790) + open test hub
tasks.detail: Starts python http.server 8790 if nothing listens, regenerates work/local-test.html, opens it.

tasks.label: Review: Oct 18 Level 1 privacy contact sheets
tasks.detail: Opens capture-local/grimes-L1-2026-10-18-review/contact-sheet-*.jpg and prints the checklist (faces, screens, documents, restroom photo). Read-only.

tasks.label: Review: Gaussian before/after (Level 1 corridors)
tasks.detail: Opens work/web-matrix/quality/before-after.png and the live Oct 18 Gaussian compare page (needs the 8790 server).

tasks.label: Review: multifloor walk (local)
tasks.detail: Opens the localhost-only Levels 1-3 overlay walk (data in capture-local/grimes-oct18-floors, provisional, never published). Needs the 8790 server.

tasks.label: Test: all unit tests
tasks.detail: Runs every node tests/*.test.cjs/.mjs and the Python unittest suite, prints a summary. No browser, no GPU.

tasks.label: Test: web matrix smoke (headless, ~3 min, Mac lags)
tasks.detail: Headless Chrome across captures/modes/styles. Takes about 3 minutes and lags the Mac; close other heavy apps first. Writes evidence under work/web-matrix/.

inputs.description: Zone to train (Level 3 preset only; superseded, see Gaussian: list zones)
Random seed (integer; default pipeline seed is 42; try 42 43 44)
Level 1 zone (Sep 17 / Oct 18); see Gaussian: list zones
